testnetCompromise: Base Sepolia has exactly ONE Chainlink feed per pair, so the >=3-source constructor floor is met by deploying three ChainlinkSourceAdapter instances over the same canonical feed (distinct source addresses). This satisfies the OracleAggregator constructor mechanically but NOT the SF-1 mechanism-diversity listing criterion, and M-1's distinctness check cannot catch it either: the ADDRESSES differ, the upstream feed does not. Quorum is 3-of-3 since the H-1 remediation (quorum must reach MIN_MEDIAN=3, because a 2-element lower median is a minimum); on this testnet that costs nothing, as all three adapters read one feed and fail together anyway. A mainnet config MUST list >=5 sources per asset with quorum 3 - see base-mainnet.json oracleRemediationRequired.
